section.title: Check scope
section.para: Verify the section-owned bonding and lightning-protection provisions, with emphasis on the radome as the forward Zone 1A lightning surface.
This data module does not redefine the LPS; it checks only the structural provisions that support the LPS-owned diverter and bonding function.

section.title: Baseline check points from current SSOT
section.para: Inspect the radome bonding and ground provisions for continuity of the intended structural interface and for signs that the radome could become a preferred attachment path bypassing the diverters.
Inspect lightning-diverter mounting provisions, seal condition, moisture-ingress indicators, and any visible deterioration that could degrade RF performance or lightning behavior.

warning.para: TBD: Quantitative bonding limits, continuity thresholds, and lightning-test acceptance values are not stated in the current SSOT source set and must be sourced from controlled LPS verification records before release beyond draft-of-record.
